limitations: The municipal list is verified against official CBS 2026 membership and the provincial page stating 18 municipalities; the latter labels its map 2025.
CBS 86247NED is definitive for the administrative classification at 1 January 2026, updated 14 July 2026.
The 419 BAG settlements use the CBS annual snapshot: existing on 1 January 2026 according to the February 2026 BAG extract. CBS marks settlement data provisional and subject to later BAG changes.
This file is a complete municipal and annual-settlement research frame, not a claim of a complete employer census.

Bilingual historical names, industrial-park marketing names, postal addresses and municipality boundaries are not interchangeable. Normalised search variants remove diacritics only and are not alternative statutory names.
Research centres are selected to organise employer searches, while every official settlement remains available in settlements.
Company workplaces require official address evidence; common locality names can also occur outside Friesland. No exact boundary geometry or geocoding is supplied.
